title: War of the Camisards
summary: The English Wikipedia article "War of the Camisards", at revision 1370749976, opens: "The War of the Camisards or the Cévennes War was an uprising of Protestant peasants known as Camisards in the Cévennes and Languedoc during the reign of Louis XIV. The uprising was a response to the Edict of Fontainebleau in 1685." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16640426, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1704 uprising of Protestant peasants in France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
